definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese bedding consisting of a mattress and quilt that can be folded and stored during the day.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いて→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{布団|ふとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}みます→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧。
examples.english: I fold the futon in the morning.

notes:
{布団|ふとん} consists of a mattress (⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧) and a quilt (⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧).

TYPES OF FUTON:
- ⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧: mattress (bottom)
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧: comforter (top)
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧: blanket
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧: pillow

COMMON VERBS:
- {布団|ふとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to lay out the futon
- {布団|ふとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}む→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧: to fold the futon
- {布団|ふとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to air out the futon
- {布団|ふとん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get into bed

CULTURAL NOTE: Japanese futons are stored in closets (⟦{押|お}し{入|い}れ→押し入れ：01345_oshiire⟧) during the day to save space.
